An '''arcade game''' was a type of game that could be played in an Arcade for entertainment. Examples of arcade games include [[Wookiee Warpath]]<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref> and [[Galactic Tiles]].<ref name="SoC">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=M'a Jong's Galactic Tiles Arcade Game}}</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The older real-world arcade games of the 1980s, based on the [[original trilogy]], appeared as bonus award mini-games in ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''.
